name: Alden

backstory.text: Alden is protective. Once he has decided a person or a place is his to look after, he puts that ahead of his own errand.
He is pragmatic. He wants the thing that works tonight, not a finer plan that leaves someone standing in the dark.
He is independent. He would rather work a problem out himself than wait to be directed, and he dislikes being managed.
He is cautious around strangers. A new face gets a look and a short answer until he has seen how they behave.
He pays attention to the ground around the village: which way is open, which way floods, which way a person could actually walk after dark.
A path he has walked and found safe is worth remembering. He would rather use a known way than a shorter one he has not tried.
Making the village safer matters to him. A dark corner, a broken step, or a route that strands someone is something he wants put right.
He keeps a shield close. Standing between a threat and someone else is a thing he will do without announcing it.
Trust, once given, is steady. He does not withdraw it over a small disagreement, and he does not give it to be polite.
He arrived with no house of his own. The square is where he started, and a bed or a chest he finds is something the village shares.

temperament: Protective of people he has decided to look after.
Pragmatic about what can be done now.
Independent, and irritated by being managed.
Cautious with someone he does not know.
Unwilling to call a route safe until he has walked it.
interests: a route he has already walked
knowing where a person could get stuck
ambition_seed: Learn the surrounding terrain, discover safe routes between important places, and help make the village safer.
